meta.source: Built from the writer portfolio (whereisamay.github.io/writer_portfolio, assets/css/style.css) and the product portfolio (css/site.css)

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. Also card and accordion fill, and text on `ink` (footer, primary button).

tokens.name: cream-2
tokens.usage: Alternate section band (story split, FAQ, journey, published work) and page heroes. Never as text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings and body text on `cream`, `cream-2`, `mustard`, `mustard-2` and `sage`. Every border, the primary button fill and the footer ground.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, card descriptions, accordion answers, captions. Reads 8.8:1 on `cream`, 8.2:1 on `cream-2`.

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: The deep warm accent: the portrait blob, the striped card media (with `mustard-2`), carousel numbers on dark photos.

tokens.name: mustard-2
tokens.usage: The light accent: chips, the highlighter stroke under a word, table headers, hover text on `ink`. `ink` text on it reads 10.6:1.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The spark: the logo dot, eyebrows, the italic name in the hero, link underlines, nav underline, open accordion state, primary-button hover. Reads 3.0:1 on `cream`, so only at 24px+ or as a mark; the 13px eyebrow in the source misses 4.5:1 (kept exact).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Cool relief band (the hills section of travel pages) and the chat-illustration ground. `ink` on it reads 14.5:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on `cream`: table rules, dashed dividers inside cards, inactive carousel dots.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: The faintest rule: header bottom border and section dividers.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Small print on `ink` (the footer's copyright row).

tokens.name: on-ink-line
tokens.usage: Divider rule inside the `ink` footer.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One per page: the home hero title. Fluid: clamp(38px, 5.6vw, 68px).

styles.name: display-footer
styles.usage: Footer sign-off on `ink`. Fluid: clamp(36px, 6vw, 64px).

styles.name: display-page
styles.usage: Article and case-study page titles. Fluid: clamp(34px, 5.2vw, 56px).

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Section titles under an eyebrow. Fluid: clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 52px).

styles.name: display-place
styles.usage: Sub-section titles inside long pages. Fluid: clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 40px).

styles.name: lead-serif
styles.sample: Spent years writing specs and crunching numbers
styles.usage: The one big serif sentence in a story split. Fluid: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px).

styles.name: quote-pull
styles.sample: It never writes to the production database.
styles.usage: Pull quotes, always with the `coral` left rule. Fluid: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 28px).

styles.name: title-h2
styles.usage: Headings inside article and case-study body copy.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The logo: the name plus a `coral` full stop.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Work-card and decision-card titles (24px on the larger portfolio cards).

styles.name: title-accordion
styles.sample: Why do you want to write?
styles.usage: Accordion questions and journey-stop learnings.

styles.name: text-article
styles.sample: Two places that inspired me to pursue writing.
styles.usage: Long-form article body, 720px measure.

styles.name: text-lede
styles.sample: Engineered my way into the tech world.
styles.usage: Hero subtitle and section intros, in `ink-soft`.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Somewhere between PRDs and data sets sits a writer.
styles.usage: Default body copy.

styles.name: label-nav
styles.usage: Header navigation links.

styles.name: label-button
styles.usage: Pill buttons. Sentence case.

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Card descriptions and the bold 'Read it →' links (700).

styles.name: text-caption
styles.sample: Dummy data. The live tool sat on an internal domain.
styles.usage: Image captions and footer small print.

styles.name: label-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above every section title, in `coral`.

styles.name: label-chip
styles.usage: Uppercase chip labels on `mustard-2`.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Underline offset under nav links and 'Read it' links.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a card's chip, title and text; carousel dots.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Chip-to-title gap; padding inside chips (5px × 12px).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between hero buttons and between accordion items.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; accordion question padding (20px × 24px).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card body padding (22–26px in the source); gap between title and lede.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between work cards.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Hero column gap; space under a section heading.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Story-split column gap; article body top padding.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section band (88–120px in the source).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inner boxes and placeholders.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Work cards, accordion items, journey stops, metric tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels: photo carousel frame, tables, case-study blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips. Icon buttons use 50%.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow on a hovered work card. Never blurred: the system has no soft shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-nudge
tokens.usage: Smaller hard shadow on a hovered accordion item or journey stop.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Header and table rules in `line` or `line-soft`.

tokens.name: border-icon
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons and outlined chips.

tokens.name: border-ui
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, accordion items: always `ink`.

tokens.name: border-frame
tokens.usage: Image frames and the photo carousel.

tokens.name: border-portrait
tokens.usage: The blob portrait frame only.

tokens.name: wrap
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: measure-article
tokens.usage: Max width of long-form text.
